description: Publish a new immutable policy version. Pin expectedCurrentVersion to prevent overwriting a concurrent update. Publishing invalidates unclaimed handoffs pinned to the old version. Reuse operationId only for exact retries. Example: invoke quality_policy_publish with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

expectedCurrentVersion.description: Current version number expected before updating; prevents conflicting writes.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

policyId.description: Unique identifier of the quality policy.

rules.description: Quality policy rules encoded as JSON text.

workspaceToken.description: Secret API token for the workspace; keep it private.

name: quality_policy_publish
